VISUAL.description: Inspect actual desktop/mobile/no-JS reader and five PDF pages; images/captions/references/related links remain readable.

COPY.description: Deliver complete matching LinkedIn/Medium copies with final verified website/PDF URLs, references and image/alt/caption instructions. Author handles later native editor previews and platform publication; those actions do not block website release.
